descriptions.value:
A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system. 
 This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface – Provisioning (OCI-P) service. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive files from the filesystem with the privileges of the Cisco BroadWorks user.

descriptions.description: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

exploits.value: In November 2026, this vulnerability was added to the Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) database of the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA).

descriptions.value: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

supportingMedia.value: Upgrade to UnrealIRCd 6.2.7.1 or later. Alternatively, apply the hot-patch to fix the issue without restart: ./unrealircd hot-patch bundle-20261107

solutions.value: Upgrade to UnrealIRCd 6.2.7.1 or later. Alternatively, apply the hot-patch to fix the issue without restart: ./unrealircd hot-patch bundle-20261107

supportingMedia.value: Add the following line to the configuration file of all servers until the patch or upgrade is applied: blacklist-module "labeled-response";

workarounds.value: Add the following line to the configuration file of all servers until the patch or upgrade is applied: blacklist-module "labeled-response";

cna.title: Local privilege escalation to root in the DynamicCLI daemon via local world-writable control socket

descriptions.value: The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

descriptions.description: CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource.
